## Resolution method

Each Socrata (NYC Open Data) dataset was resolved by:
1. Querying the Socrata Catalog API by title
2. Confirming returned dataset ID against the public data dictionary
3. Verifying column names and types
4. Pinning the ID in `config.yaml`

If resolution failed, resolution was halted and reported; no IDs were guessed.

For non-Socrata sources (LION), links were obtained from the NYC DCP distribution page.

---

## Download instructions

To reproduce this project:

```bash
# Run Stage 0 to download all sources
jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace src/s0_resolve_sources.ipynb
```

Raw files go to `data/raw/`. **Do not commit.** See `.gitignore`.
